title: Weekly Cycle Atlas Edit 2025-07-07
summary: On behalf of @atlas-axis , we are submitting the Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle proposal below. This proposal includes the following edits: Update Sky Spread - Updates the value of the Sky Spread to 10 basis points. Add Exception To Star Agent Instance Operationalization Restriction - Clarifies that Star Agents can operationalize their Allocation System Instances under certain conditions. Remove Documents Related To Offboarded Peg Stability Modules - Removes documents related to offboarded Peg Stability Modules. Increase Sky Spread Replace A.2.9.1.2.2.3.4 - Sky Spread (Portal) / A.2.10 - Sky Spread (GitHub) to read as follows: A.2.10 - Sky Spread (Core) - A fixed margin of 0.1% (Sky Spread) forms part of the overall differential between the Savings Rate and the Base Rate, representing the premium earned by Sky for facilitating the ecosystem’s financing. The total spread between the Savings Rate and the Base Rate is therefore 0.3%. Replace A.3.2.2.2.1 - Relationship To Base Rate (Portal) / A.3.2 - Core Stability Parameters - Parameters - Sky Savings Rate - Relationship To Base Rate (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.2 - Core Stability Parameters - Parameters - Sky Savings Rate - Relationship To Base Rate (Core) - The Sky Savings Rate is 0.3% below the Base Rate. This difference is equal to the sum of (1) the 0.2% Accessibility Reward Fee (see A.2.4 - Fees ) and (2) the 0.1% Sky Spread (see A.3.3 - Sky Spread ). Replace A.3.2.2.3.1 - Relationship To Base Rate (Portal) / A.3.2 - Core Stability Parameters - Parameters - Agent Rate - Relationship To Base Rate (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.2 - Core Stability Parameters - Parameters - Agent Rate - Relationship To Base Rate (Core) - The Agent Rate is 0.1% below the Base Rate. This is equal to the Sky Savings Rate plus the 0.2% Accessibility Reward Fee (see A.2.4 - Fees ). Add Exception To Star Agent Instance Operationalization Restriction Replace A.1.13.3.4 - Agent Role Delineation (Portal) / A.1.14 - Agent Role Delineation (GitHub) to read as follows: A.1.14 - Agent Role Delineation (Core) - Whenever a Star Agent’s strategy involves any on-chain or off-chain interaction with Sky Protocol resources or infrastructure, including the Sky Primitives, the operationalization of that strategy is generally restricted to Executor Agents. There is an exception for Star Agents directly operationalizing Allocation System Primitive Instances using internal, proprietary strategies, see A.2.4 - Operationalization Of Allocation Instances . Remove Documents Related To Offboarded Peg Stability Modules Replace A.3.4.2.7.1 - Peg Stability Modules (Portal) / A.3.4 - Peg Stability Modules (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.4 - Peg Stability Module (Core) - The documents herein outline the legacy Peg Stability Module which supported Dai and USDS peg stability under Sky Core management. Going forward, the PSM will be transitioned to Grove. Delete A.3.4.2.7.1.2 - Other Peg Stability Modules (Portal) / A.3.4 - Other Peg Stability Modules (GitHub) and its subdocuments.
